@bsMax = 1.0

age_presets = {
	age_preset_child = {
		mode = multiply
		curve = { { 0.0 0.5 } { 0.2 1.0 } }
	}
}

color_genes = {
	hair_color = {
		color = hair
		blend_range = { 0.0 0.0 }
	}
}

morph_genes = {
	gene_nose_size = {
		nose_size = {
			index = 0
			male = {
				setting = {
					attribute = "head_bs_nose_size_max"
					curve = { { 0.0 0.0 } { 0.5 0.0 } { 1.0 @bsMax } }
					age = age_preset_child
				}
				setting = {
					attribute = "head_bs_nose_size_min"
					curve = { { 0.0 @bsMax } { 0.5 0.0 } { 1.0 0.0 } }
					age = age_preset_child
				}
			}
			female = male
			boy = male
			girl = female
		}
	}
}

accessory_genes = {
	hairstyles = {
		inheritable = yes
		short_hairstyles = {
			index = 0
			male = {
				1 = male_hair_short_01
				3 = male_hair_short_02
			}
			female = { 1 = female_hair_short_01 }
			boy = male
			girl = female
		}
	}
}
